scope: Final packaged S4 movie identity, source capture provenance, encode records, recorded full-decode completion and actual container/stream metadata. This is separate from visual gameplay review, perceptual audio audition, native input validation and stress profiles.
method: Read-only hashing of current movies, encode reports, capture CSV/check/WAV records and existing logs; comparison of every source-frame ledger entry to the completed runner; recomputation of ordered frame-ledger digests; direct MP4 atom and WAV-header parsing. No encoder, decoder, game, build or Git process was launched by this summary.

source.source: Actual gameplay JPEG screenshot callbacks plus Unreal master-output WAV
source.input_provenance: Recorder observation/input_events.csv distinguish scripted production dispatch from passive native input; this assembler does not infer human operation.
source.ordered_frame_identity_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON lines [relative filename, original audio_seconds string, JPEG SHA256] in CSV order

encode.exit_code_evidence: Both actual portable sidecar and completed assembly log record encoded=true and encoder_exit_code=0. Current movie byte count and SHA256 match the sidecar.
encode.source_images_treatment: Captured images held according to callback timestamps; first image held from audio time zero. CFR output duplicates or drops captured frames on the 30fps grid; no generated pixels, motion interpolation or retiming to hide stalls.
encode.audio_treatment: AAC transcode of the supplied engine WAV at original duration; this assembler does not replace, pad, stretch or synthesize audio. The source gameplay may itself use provisional synthesized sound assets.
encode.chapter_note: Raw chapters.csv is retained and hash-bound as capture provenance; no MP4 chapter tracks/references or chapter list were present, and the assembler was not given its optional chapter flag.
warnings: FFmpeg guessed stereo channel layout; actual WAV header and MP4 audio entry both independently confirm two channels.
FFmpeg swscaler reported use of a deprecated pixel format; the completed decode log describes full-range yuvj420p. This summary does not claim a perceptual color review.

video.codec_evidence: avc1 MP4 sample entry and H.264 High in the completed full decode log

audio.codec_evidence: mp4a MP4 sample entry and AAC LC in the completed full decode log

raw_MP4_timing_metadata.method: Read-only MP4 mvhd/tkhd/mdhd/stts/stsz/stsd/elst metadata; no media decoder/encoder launched.

timing.source_endpoint_policy_scope: The final source callback precedes the unmodified recorded WAV endpoint by a positive interval no greater than0.5s. This source assembly policy does not assert equal encoded video/audio stream durations.
timing.final_image_display: Video samples end before the audio/container. A player may retain the last decoded image during the remaining audio; that implicit final-image display was not verified by continuous playback here. No additional encoded terminal frames are invented or claimed.
timing.AAC_duration_note: Raw AAC media duration includes1024 priming samples. The audio edit starts at sample1024. Track/container/edit durations use the1000Hz movie timebase and differ from the exact WAV endpoint by less than1ms.

CFR_conversion.note: The assembler resamples timestamp-held JPEGs onto a30fps grid, where duplication or dropping is expected. The net frame-count increase is measured; individual duplicate/drop counts were not recorded by these warning-level encode logs. No motion interpolation or generated intermediate pixels is claimed.

decode_verification.exit_code_provenance: Root observed both completed FFmpeg process exit codes as0. The FFmpeg text logs themselves do not store a numeric process exit code.

limitations: No continuous movie playback or perceptual audio audition was performed for this verification; full decode tests codec readability, not perceived gameplay/audio quality.
Source callbacks run at approximately27.35 and26.74 per second in these recordings. The30fps MP4s do not demonstrate a30fps game-performance result or every rendered engine frame.

Current source JPEG payloads were not all rehashed during this summary; their complete ordered hash ledgers match the final capture runner, and actual current raw records/WAVs/movie payloads were checked.
Video and audio do not end at identical times. Measured MP4 timing and the distinction between source endpoint hold and implicit player display are recorded explicitly.
Existing full decode logs and root's observed exit codes are reused. No new full decode was launched during the separate profiling work.
Chapter timing CSVs remain source provenance; the final movies contain no embedded chapters.
This report does not establish human OS input, a survival playthrough, environmental isolation, stress-profile performance, visual approval, audio-phase coverage or final publication approval.
